evidence.note: The active 'Title' nav item is in blue text on a pale pill, marking the current section (focus role).
Blurred blue blobs of the same hue scatter across the slide (top centre, right edge, bottom centre, small dots), encoding nothing.
Title, subtitle and byline are neutral ink/grey; no state, loss or alarm colours appear.

rationale: The blue in the nav marks the current section, which is a legitimate focus use. The same blue is also spread across the background as ambient blobs that encode no role, which is decorative use of a role colour. That matches the fail descriptor.
